name: Pollo AI
title: pollo.ai
shortDescription: Pollo AI is an all-in-one platform for generating AI-driven videos and images, catering to creatives and marketers. Users can animate still images, maintain consistency in videos, and transform text into videos. Ideal for creating dynamic content in various styles like anime and cartoons, it simplifies content creation with user-friendly tools and templates.
pros: Offers both video and image AI models
cons: Potential privacy concerns with cookie usage
